<!-- uv-next-slice: recipe-entrypoint-retirement -->

## Goal

Perform the mechanical D-038 post-merge lifecycle closure for `project-identity-v2-compat-reader` after PR #89 merged as `a0150e1543b8b4c8f5d3ae8d1b701118fcb112d2`.

## Changes

- transition `project-context/ACTIVE_SLICE.json` from `review` to `idle` with `active_slice: null`;
- record `project-identity-v2-compat-reader` / PR #89 / merge `a0150e1543b8b4c8f5d3ae8d1b701118fcb112d2` as `last_completed`;
- synchronize `PROJECT_STATE.md` with the accepted merged Stage-19 result and final review/CI evidence;
- set the single next handoff to `recipe-entrypoint-retirement` and synchronize `NEXT_TASK.md` to that bounded D-070 scope.

No runtime, test, schema, API, frontend or product behavior changes are included.

## Verification

PR #89 merged from exact reviewed HEAD `a237be2ff32a7fca280cd4f6b414ba19cd5870e6` after a fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review returned `CURRENT / PASS / 0 findings / 12 rejected candidates`. The final post-review exact-head CI #4740 (`33871108872`) passed all five permanent checks, including both full unit suites, API integration, real-media, frontend audit/build and browser Product Truth on Ubuntu and Windows; all inline review threads were resolved before merge.

Require the repository's five permanent CI checks on exact closure head `244830f656eda6328588b73a69f0e5f302eeb7c8` before merge. This is a mechanical lifecycle/context closure and does not require a new independent semantic review.

## Architecture impact

None. This PR records the already-merged Stage-19 compatibility boundary and returns repository development memory to canonical `idle`; it introduces no new application authority.

## Known limitations

This closure does not execute `recipe-entrypoint-retirement`, `/execution-plan` retirement, legacy direction/tool migration, Product Orchestrator retirement or Stage8 retirement. Those remain separate bounded D-070 slices.

## Next task

After this closure merges and `main` is verified lifecycle-idle, run the mandatory fresh bootstrap from that exact `main`, then open `recipe-entrypoint-retirement` as the next bounded slice. Exact-scan the remaining Recipe Registry creation/metadata callers, migrate any real modern caller to Production Direction / Studio project creation authority, and preserve old-project read/import compatibility.
